description: This file defines the ShippingService interface, outlining methods for managing shipping configurations, modules, quotes, and related operations within a sales management system.

classes.name: ShippingService
classes.description: An interface providing methods for handling shipping-related operations such as configuration, quote retrieval, and module management.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns a list of countries supported for shipping, based on merchant store configuration.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of supported country codes for a merchant store.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Provides a list of available shipping modules.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Retrieves configured shipping modules for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves configuration settings for a shipping quote module.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches shipping configuration including types and packages for a store.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves shipping configuration for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a shipping quote module configuration based on module code.

methods.name: getPackagesDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed package information for a list of shipping products.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Retrieves shipping quotes for given products and delivery details.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches configuration details for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves custom shipping configuration for a module.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Builds a shipping summary based on selected shipping option for order calculation.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Provides a list of countries to which shipments are supported.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if shipping is required based on cart items and store configuration.
